BotPage.metaTitle: WivWav Crawler Info — For Site Owners
BotPage.metaDescription: How the WivWav crawler identifies itself, what it collects, and how to control or block it.
BotPage.heading: WivWav Crawler Info

what.heading: What is WivWav?
what.p1: WivWav is a free search index for wheelchair accessible vehicles (WAVs). Our crawler visits publicly accessible listing pages across many independent websites and lets people search across all of them in one place, the way a general search engine indexes pages from across the web.

ua.heading: Our user-agent
ua.p1: Our crawler identifies itself with the following user-agent string:
ua.p3: You can match this string in your server logs to identify our traffic. If this string ever changes, we will update it on this page first.

data.heading: What we collect
data.p1: From each listing page we crawl, we collect publicly visible vehicle listing details — things like price, mileage, location, vehicle facts (make, model, year), and the listing’s photos and description as published on the page. We do not create an account, log in, or access anything that isn’t already visible to any visitor.

use.heading: What we do with it
use.p1: Collected details are indexed for search and shown to WivWav users as summarized facts and short snippets in search results. Every listing we show links back to the original page on your site — WivWav is a discovery layer that sends visitors to you, not a destination that replaces a visit to your site.

robots.heading: robots.txt compliance
robots.p1: Our crawler checks robots.txt before requesting any page on your site and honors every Disallow rule that applies to it, including rules written specifically for our bot by name (see below). A missing or unreadable robots.txt is treated as fully open, never as a reason to skip the check.

rate.heading: Crawl rate
rate.p1: We pace our requests conservatively and add randomized delays between them, so our crawler never bursts a large volume of traffic at one site. We also honor a site’s explicitly declared Crawl-delay directive where one is set.

block.heading: How to block just WivWav
block.p1: If you’d like to exclude only our crawler without affecting search engines or other bots, add a block targeting our user-agent name to your robots.txt:
block.p3: We check for this on every crawl and will stop requesting your site once it’s in place. You can also scope the block to specific paths instead of your whole site by listing them under Disallow individually.

noCircumvention.heading: What we never do
noCircumvention.p1: Our crawler never logs in, creates an account, or agrees to any terms of service to access a page. If a site blocks us — through robots.txt, an IP block, a CAPTCHA, or any other access control — we stop and do not attempt to get around it.

funding.heading: How WivWav is funded
funding.p1: WivWav is currently free to use, with no ads. If hosting and infrastructure costs ever require it as the service grows, we may introduce minimal, non-intrusive advertising to cover those costs — not as a business model built around competing with the sites we index.

contact.heading: Questions, removal, or reporting an issue
contact.body: If you’d like us to stop crawling your site, correct something, or you have any other question about our crawler, email <mail>privacy@wivwav.com</mail> with your site’s URL. We will respond and comply promptly.

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: How WivWav handles data from site visitors and third-party sources.
PrivacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy

overview.heading: Overview
overview.p1: WivWav is a free, open-access search tool for wheelchair accessible vehicles. No account or login is required to use the site. This policy explains what information is collected, how it is used, and your rights as a visitor.

collected.heading: Data Collected from Visitors
collected.p1: WivWav does not require registration or login. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information (PII) such as your name, email address, or phone number.
collected.p2: Standard web server and hosting infrastructure may automatically record the following for operational and security purposes:

list3.i1: IP address (anonymized or truncated where feasible)

collected.p4: This information is used solely to operate and improve the service and is not sold or shared with advertising networks.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.p1: WivWav uses browser localStorage to remember your optional theme preference (Spring, Summer, Fall, or Winter). This data never leaves your device and is not transmitted to our servers.
cookies.p2: We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies. Any session cookies set by infrastructure providers are used only to maintain operational security and are not used for cross-site tracking.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Data Sources
thirdParty.p1: Listing data on WivWav is sourced from publicly accessible vehicle listing websites, eBay’s official Browse API, and the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) public API. We aggregate and index this information to make it searchable. We do not control the privacy practices of those sources.
thirdParty.p2: Some listing sources include private-party (“For Sale By Owner”) vehicle listings. When WivWav indexes a private-seller listing, we store publicly available vehicle and location details (such as make, model, year, price, mileage, city, and state) along with any images published on the source listing page. We do not display or index the personal phone number of a private seller.
thirdParty.p3: When a private-seller listing is no longer found on its source site, we automatically clear the seller’s phone number, name, description, ZIP code, and images, and delete the underlying scraped page and image references, within 30 days.
thirdParty.p4: If you are a private seller and would like your listing removed from WivWav sooner, please contact <mail>privacy@wivwav.com</mail> with the listing URL and we will remove it promptly.
thirdParty.p5: We do not share visitor data with dealers or any third party for marketing purposes.

analytics.heading: Analytics
analytics.p1: If analytics are in use, they are configured to minimize data collection — for example, with IP anonymization and no cross-site tracking. This policy will be updated to name any analytics provider before it is activated.

children.heading: Children’s Privacy
children.p1: WivWav is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email <mail>privacy@wivwav.com</mail>.

informational.p3: Always verify vehicle details, accessibility features, and pricing directly with the dealer or seller before making any purchase decision.

accuracy.heading: Data Accuracy Limitations
accuracy.p1: Listing data is sourced automatically from third-party dealer sites and the NHTSA public API. WivWav does not independently verify listing details. Data may be:

list2.i1: Out of date — vehicles may have sold or changed in price
list2.i2: Incomplete — not all accessibility features may be captured

accuracy.p3: WivWav makes no warranties, express or implied, about the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of any information presented on the site.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
liability.p1: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, WivWav and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, the Service or any information obtained through it.

use.heading: Permitted Use
use.p1: You may use the Service for personal, non-commercial research into wheelchair accessible vehicles. You may not:

list2.i1: Scrape or bulk-download content from the site in ways that disrupt the Service
list2.i2: Use the Service to build a competing aggregation product without permission

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Links
